headline: 9 on-chain contract addresses and accounts identified for Bybit Staked SOL; uses Sanctum pools program on Solana with 1.2M+ SOL staked through single validator.
short_headline: 9 accounts catalogued on Solana; single validator pool

findings.text: Solana block explorer (Solscan, Solana Compass) name-tag search for 'bbSOL' and 'Bybit' surfaced 9 on-chain contract and account addresses across the stake pool infrastructure.

Official website https://www.bybit.com/en/web3/staking/BybitSOL references the product but does not provide a canonical 'Deployed Contracts' page with listed addresses; Solana Compass acts as the primary public address index.
No audit links provided in per-protocol context. Protocol website contains no linked audit reports in fetched content.
No GitHub repository recorded in per-protocol context. Deployment artifacts not directly discoverable via GitHub.
Protocol.chains contains only 'Solana'; single-chain deployment. No multi-chain enumeration required.
Stake pool is not a factory producing child contracts; it is itself a single pool. No child enumeration performed.

All 9 addresses classified per controlled vocabulary: 1 pool (stake pool), 1 token (bbSOL mint), 3 admin/authority roles (manager, staker authority, deposit authority), 1 treasury/fee (manager fee account), 1 storage (validator list), 1 guardian (withdraw authority), 1 reserve (stake reserve). Actor classes: unknown (only on-chain bytecode reading would determine; deferred to control slice).

All 9 addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to fetched Solana Compass stake pool page with on-chain addresses rendered. Each address hyperlinked on https://solanacompass.com/stake-pools/2aMLkB5p5gVvCwKkdSo5eZAL1WwhZbxezQr1wxiynRhq.

rationale.verdict: Discovery indexed 9 Solana contract and account addresses from block explorer search and protocol documentation. Stake pool uses Sanctum pools program with single active validator. All addresses traceable to high-confidence on-chain source (Solana Compass public explorer integration). No GitHub or audit artifacts located; deferred to unknowns[]. No multi-chain or factory enumeration required.

evidence.shows: Official protocol website describing bbSOL product as exchange-backed liquid staking token for Solana; does not link deployed contract addresses.

Solana Compass stake pool details page rendering 9 on-chain account addresses: stake pool (2aMLkB5p5gVvCwKkdSo5eZAL1WwhZbxezQr1wxiynRhq), pool mint/token (Bybit2vBJGhPF52GBdNaQfUJ6ZpThSgHBobjWZpLPb4B), manager (GnTFrdUzWgdbfXVYZiGQn56e9HXiqYCBbHRZTmxcz6Fs), staker (EG976hUYS3Mwf595uk9irszydggWzB3tBDobbMffyScq), stake deposit authority (3PsXP9ZjTAjWqM4YQJsKuT3DcyhqHaJ8vrXRfMf68Xoy), withdraw authority (3pFTQjRVwcJHSpUNH5n1hx6Jwx7V3EzJDDHaKuwExyGJ), validator list (BPVx5RBixdZVecvoDSFECMc8jXkLNTmQp65WYKJz9nr5), manager fee account (HcacehDEp8W4wSdy2oi4HgVoSWwMJDr1kZwXUBSuFfKK), reserve stake (7huMsYqSXb1m4okiAJgQLPTamgHD2GvWhAou7vhzF51r). protocol_metadata.about: Bybit Staked SOL (bbSOL) is an exchange-backed liquid staking token that allows users to stake SOL through Bybit while maintaining liquidity. Users deposit SOL and receive bbSOL tokens representing their staked position, earning staking rewards reflected in the token's appreciating value. The protocol leverages Sanctum's battle-tested liquid staking infrastructure and integrates with Bybit's broader Web3 ecosystem.
